name: Lucky Clovers
description: Four clovers sit on boxes around the board. Tap a box to grab its clover — it flies up on a rainbow trail into the tray above the maze. Fill all four slots for a gold coin jackpot.
howToPlay: Tap the boxes with a clover on top to collect them. One clover is on an ice box (break the ice first by tapping the two boxes next to it) and one is on a box locked in by its neighbours (clear one of them to open it up). Fill all 4 slots in the tray for the money celebration.
author: simaocristo
